title: Flappy Bird 3D
description: Fly a selectable 3D bird down an endless ocean causeway, flapping through randomized pipe gaps for a high score.

prompt.objective: Build a one-button 3D flying game with endless obstacles, quick restarts, and scoring.

mintAssets.brief: Three colorful flying characters, a glossy pipe obstacle, and a puffy cloud.
Short flap, score, and collision sounds with a retro-arcade feel.

experience: Start, flap, and restart with keyboard, click, or tap.
Recycle randomized obstacles, count cleared gaps, and offer three characters.
prompt.visualDirection: Bright toy-like arcade art, chunky type, and a centered chase camera.

thumbnail.alt: A yellow 3D bird facing a green pipe course over a bright blue ocean beneath the Flappy Bird 3D title.
